title: Field instruments
blurb: Play the air in front of the camera like a theremin: your hands choose the pitch and the loudness, and each instrument changes what the fingers, the face and the open hand do.

title: Air instruments
blurb: Mime an instrument and it plays: strike a drum, pluck a bass, strum a guitar or blow a flute at nothing.

title: Chords and harmony
blurb: Point at chords instead of notes: a map or a wheel of a key's chords, a keyboard or a band that sets the chords for you to play over, a score whose chords you conduct.

title: Sign instruments
blurb: Fingerspell American Sign Language to the camera and see the sign, or hear a chord for each letter from A to G.
